## FM27 Trainer 0.2.7 — Tactics page, and the Mac app finds FM again

### New
- **Tactics page.** The app reads your tactic from FM: the eleven places with their role in and out of
  possession, and each player's positions and attributes. Per place you see how well the player fits, whether
  someone outside the eleven fits better, the best eleven for the tactic, and roles in the same line that suit a
  player better. You can look at all three of your tactics. It only reads: nothing is changed in FM.
  - Which attributes belong to a role is our own estimate, not a number from FM: treat the score as a guide.
  - Left and right are derived from the order of the places.
  - A few roles are not named yet; they show as a number (for example `#41`).
  - Checked live on the Mac (Steam). On Windows it has only been tested in simulation: please report what you see.

- **More than one manager in a save, and other teams of your club.** If a save has two or more human managers,
  the Training page now lets you choose which one the app works for (club, squad, transfers and training follow
  that choice). Until now the app always took the first manager, so training for a second team was written to
  the wrong club. You can also choose another team of your club (under 21, under 18, B team) and let the app plan
  its training.
  - A youth or B team only works if FM keeps a training calendar of its own for it, which is when you run that
    team's training yourself. Otherwise the app says the calendar was not found.
  - The plan uses the values you read last: read the Breakdown of the team you chose.
  - Tested in simulation only. Please report what you see.
- **Rest level.** Settings → Planner → Rest: *More rest* ends every training day and the day before a match with
  Rest; *Less rest* adds a tactical session after Recovery on the day after a match. *Balanced* is the plan as it
  was.

### Fixed
- **Intel Mac: the app did not start** ("Library not loaded: libswiftCoreMedia.dylib", #5). The Intel half of
  0.2.6 depended on a system library it could not find. That dependency is gone. Checked by starting the Intel
  build under Rosetta; not tested on a real Intel Mac.
- **Mac: "No Football Manager window found" while FM was running.** With FM full screen on its own Space, the app
  could not see the window from another Space. It now finds and reads the FM window wherever it is, so auto-read
  also works while you are looking at the app. Without Screen Recording permission the app now says so.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SemHiel2003/fm27-trainer/compare/v0.2.6...v0.2.7
